objective: A suite pass that the tester declares in several blocks counts as one complete run only when the blocks are the test command.

criteria.text: Every block of a split pass starts with the test command, otherwise the pass does not count
A pass with the whole test command counts as one run

fails: a split pass made of blocks that are not the test command counts as a complete run; a regression
env: Node 24 and the standard library; the proof runs with node --test in a copy of this folder
output: the verdict of the critic on the issue
